selection_rule: Select standards during design based on audience, risk, intervention, platform, and organizational policy. A reference framework does not become governing until the implementing authority approves it.

standards.name: Learning-Transfer Evaluation Model
standards.verification: primary source and organization approval required

standards.name: WCAG 2.2
standards.use: web accessibility conformance target when adopted
standards.verification: specific target and scope must be approved

standards.name: WCAG2ICT
standards.use: guidance for applying WCAG to non-web documents and software

standards.name: SCORM
standards.verification: target LMS and approved version must be tested

standards.name: xAPI
standards.use: learning-experience statements when an approved LRS and vocabulary exist
standards.verification: architecture, privacy, vocabulary, and reporting approval required
